move: three panels slide in together from alternating sides, squeeze beat, name swap
how: Three stacked video panels slide in at the same instant from alternating sides (xPercent ∓115, expo.out 0.9s) while all three videos pan in unison from xPercent -62 to -38 and scale 1.2 to 1.02 linearly across D. Numbers drop in, names rise from masks with expo.out, price pills pop with back.out(2), rules draw with scaleX. At 0.4D all panels squeeze to scale 0.96 and spring back with elastic.out(1,0.5) while prices bump; at 0.6D the names exit up, textContent swaps and new names rise. At 0.88D the panels leave the way they came with expo.in, rules and captions fade.
adapt: Replace the three videos, grade colours, numbers, names (and their swap words), prices and captions; panel count can change if the alternating xPercent signs and rule positions are regenerated. Keep the simultaneous entrance and the 2.4s squeeze beat.
port: mount(el, shot) builds three .panel blocks, .rule lines, .head and .foot and waits on video loadeddata; animate(el, shot, D) returns the timeline with the video-scrub onUpdate tween and offsets as fractions of D (beat 2.4/6, swap 3.6/6, exit 5.3/6). Scope selectors to el.
caveats: three simultaneous videos scrubbed via currentTime
from() tweens need immediateRender:false when rebuilt
